patterns.note: Full-width sections with content often centered or left-aligned, utilizing a dark background to create a stage for vibrant, contrasting elements.
High-contrast typography featuring oversized, bold sans-serif headings, often with a gradient fill, paired with lighter weight body text for readability on a dark background.
A dominant deep, dark background (near black) serves as a canvas for vibrant, glowing pink and purple accents, contrasted with crisp white primary text and subtle grey secondary text.
Scroll-triggered section reveals use a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation, creating a dynamic content flow as the user scrolls down the page.
Strategic integration of social proof, such as Trustpilot ratings and customer testimonials, placed prominently in the upper sections of the page to build immediate credibility.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the viewport across all scroll depths, maintaining navigation access.
Utilize a dark, almost black, background for the entire site, employing vibrant gradient overlays or canvas animations for hero and key section backgrounds to add visual depth and energy.

Employ scroll-triggered animations (likely using GSAP ScrollTrigger, as hinted) to reveal content sections with a subtle fade-in and upward slide effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold hero (~4-5x body) with smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle for buttons and cards, with some sharp edges for contrast.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the hero and between major sections, balanced in content grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, dark, almost black background as a sophisticated canvas for vibrant, glowing pink and purple accents, particularly in the oversized, gradient-filled hero typography and subtle background animations. This creates a moody yet energetic and modern aesthetic that feels premium and engaging.
